question: The Balimela Power Plant is located in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Balimela Power Plant** is located in the state of **Odisha**, India. It is a hydroelectric power plant that significantly contributes to the power supply in the region.
 
• The project is built on the **Sileru River**, which is a tributary of the Godavari River, and is situated in the Malkangiri district of Odisha.
 
• This hydroelectric project was developed jointly by the states of **Odisha** and **Andhra Pradesh**, showcasing interstate collaboration in power generation.
 
• The Balimela Dam, which is an integral part of this project, is a multipurpose dam designed for both irrigation and power generation purposes. It has helped in improving agricultural productivity in the region.
 
• The hydroelectric power station has an installed capacity of **510 MW**, consisting of multiple turbine units to generate electricity efficiently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Location and Geography:**

 
 
• The Balimela Power Plant is located in the **Malkangiri district** of Odisha, which is known for its rich natural resources and hilly terrain.
 
• The Sileru River, where the dam is constructed, flows through picturesque landscapes and provides the necessary water resources for the power plant.
 
 
 
• **Hydroelectric Power in India:**
 
 
• India has several hydroelectric power plants, which play a crucial role in the country's energy mix. Hydropower is a renewable and eco-friendly source of energy.
 
• Odisha is home to several hydroelectric projects, including the Hirakud Dam, Indravati Power Plant, and Upper Kolab Project.
 
 
 
• **Interstate Collaboration:**
 
 
• The Balimela project is an example of interstate collaboration between **Odisha** and **Andhra Pradesh** for efficient resource utilization and power generation.
 
• This collaboration highlights the importance of cooperative federalism in India’s infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• **Energy Contribution:**
 
 
• The Balimela Power Plant contributes significantly to the energy needs of both Odisha and Andhra Pradesh, ensuring reliable electricity supply to various sectors.
 
• It supports industrial development and rural electrification in the region.
 
 
 
• **Environmental and Socioeconomic Impact:**
 
 
• The project has had a positive impact on agriculture through improved irrigation facilities.
 
• It has also created employment opportunities during its construction and operational phases.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Hydropower Potential in India:**

 
 
• India is the 7th largest producer of hydropower in the world, with an estimated potential of about **145,320 MW**.
 
• Major river systems such as the Ganga, Brahmaputra, and Godavari provide significant hydropower opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Balimela Power Plant:**
 
 
• It has played a vital role in stabilizing the power grid in eastern India and supporting regional energy demands.
 
• The project is a part of Odisha's broader strategy to harness its water resources for sustainable development.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Hydropower Projects:**
 
 
• Environmental concerns, such as deforestation and displacement of local communities, often pose challenges to hydropower projects.
 
• Proper planning and implementation are necessary to balance development and conservation.
